title: Build session-health dashboard
acceptance: Show source ages, unknown, live/replay mode and prototype limitation; no green safe state.
evidence: Local fixture dashboard: six synthetic replay scenarios, independent capture/heartbeat age, unknown/stale/disconnected display, bounded activity and persistent replay/prototype labels. No live backend/device connection or credentials.

10 Node.js model tests and 43 shared Python tests passed, including four real HTTP preview-server checks. Browser verified all six scenarios, pause/expiry, no horizontal overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440 widths, and no console warnings/errors.
blocker: Fixture preview is implemented and tested. Live integration awaits accepted CS-035 and a reviewed authenticated read-only dashboard data source. Native device WSS credentials/Origin restrictions are not bypassed; no live model, phone, Pi or motor readiness is claimed.
